simulator.note: As the C3505 family (2026-10-12), like V1.5B4: the boot ROM's step into the boot SRAM, the bootloader waits for bit 8 of 0xB8000300, unpacks the application and starts it; the application moves its exception vectors (EBase 0x80002000) and starts the SEE co-processor's program at 0xA6000200 on the second core (see.SeeCore; it moves its own, EBase 0x86002000), prints its banner and attaches its drivers through remote calls with the newer chips' doorbells (60 answered and 54 of the SEE's by ~76 M instructions); its ATBM7812 demodulator answers its chip ID 0xA8 at I2C 0x40 (demods.py, the sidecar's demodModel; without it the driver retried its power-on init for ~125 M instructions).  Its screen (2026-10-13), like V1.5B4's: the first-install wizard "Welcome" ("OK (10 sec)" counting down) by ~110 M, through the newer display engine's layer at 0xB8006900 (gma_capture.de_layers).  Panel keys (2026-10-14, front_panel._FERGUSON_KEYS): the PAN_FD650K driver switches on the key byte (key - 0x5C, a jump table) and turns DIG1 / DIG2 of KI4..KI7 into the panel codes its UI maps -- KI4/DIG1 down, KI4/DIG2 exit, KI5/DIG1 left, KI5/DIG2 menu, KI6/DIG1 right, KI6/DIG2 power, KI7/DIG1 up, KI7/DIG2 OK.  Its remote (2026-10-14) takes the T650i's extended-NEC coding (ext00; its key task keeps the code's first address byte): under the default "nec" DOWN did nothing on the first-install wizard, whose countdown then started the channel search; under ext00 DOWN moves the wizard's highlight.  Its OTP memory (chips/m3821.Otp, 2026-10-14) is blank, as on an unsigned box: every 60 ticks of play the firmware checks the two 64-byte halves of its signature at 0x1C0 / 0x3A0 (0x80016FCC -> 0x8007EB28 on the T750i) and, finding them blank, shows "STB not signed!" for 5 s.  A non-blank stand-in there (tried 2026-10-14) sends its start-up down the signed path -- the signature's RSA check -- where the simulator crashed (Unicorn's long-block fault), so the sidecar gives none.

desc: Ferguson Ariva T760i firmware V1.5B0 (2021-01-28), the manufacturer's USB update image from Ferguson's download area (Ferguson_T760i_V1.5B0-28012021.zip).

Despite the .abs name it is a complete flash image: the ALi chunk chain from offset 0 -- HATB1 0x000000 (66019-01047, 2021-1-28), HDCPKey 0x02FE00 (1.0.0, 2016-7-14), maincode 0x030000 (V1.5B0, 2021-1-28), seecode 0x480000 (V1.5B0, 2021-1-28), radioback 0x5F0000 (1.0.0, 2016-7-14), seeback 0x60FF80 (1.0.0, 2016-7-14), T760i 0x620000 (1.0.0, 2016-7-14), data 0x63FF80 (1.0.0, 2016-7-14), defaultdb 0x690000 (1.0.0, 2016-12-8), userdb 0x6AFF80 (1.0.0, 2021-1-28); the maincode's CRC-32/MPEG-2 is intact.  Banners in its LZMA streams: Libcore version 17.15.0@SDK4.0ia.17.15_20171115; Libcore version 1.1.5a@SDK_20111126.

Like the T750i it has a "seecode" chunk (the SEE co-processor's code, Libcore 1.1.5a@SDK_20111126); the maincode's Libcore is 17.15.0@SDK4.0ia.17.15_20171115.  The chip is not an M3821: the C3505 is a later ALi generation (a DVB-S2 SoC; here the external AltoBeam ATBM7812 receives DVB-T2), which the simulator runs as chips/c3505.py: the M3821's boot-ROM path with the chip ID 0x3505.
